card.name: Drawing vial contents into syringe
card.fires_on: The word "into" (or "through") right after withdraw/draw and vial contents, just before "the syringe" in preparation steps. Weaker on a few unrelated words such as "striking" and "rededic-ating".

modes.label: Withdraw into syringe
modes.description: A linking word after withdraw/draw and the vial or its contents, leading to the syringe.
